Name: Rock NPC Pickaxe Interaction
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[color=#ffff00]*[/color][color=#ffffff]If you[/color] [color=#00ff00]like[/color] [color=#ffffff]my[/color] [color=#00ffff]mods[/color] [color=#ffffff]consider[/color] [color=#ff0000]Endorsing[/color]![color=#ffff00]*[/color]

This is a simple mod. It adds a pickaxe interaction for the Rock NPC. Fully animated pickaxe strike.

It will either dislike or like being hit with a pickaxe. Configurable in GMCM.

Dislike will result in a loss of 30 friendship points. Like will result in a gain of 5 friendship points.

You can strike it once per day.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
